items.q: Will you build my site for me?
items.a: No. I show you how to build it yourself with AI: the method, the tools and prompts tailored to you. You stay in control.

items.q: I’m a complete beginner. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. Just say so in your project description: I’ll adapt my explanations to your level.
On the payment page, you describe your project in one sentence. I reply personally by email within {delay}, then you get {followUpsIncluded} for your questions.

items.q: Do I need to pay for tools?
items.a: Some tools are free, others are paid. I’ll tell you which ones I use and where to start, depending on your budget.
Because it’s a focused exchange, not a course. Just what you need to get your project started.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal, under the conditions set out in the terms of sale. When you order, you ask for the exchange to start right away, and you lose that right once my answer has been fully delivered.
Yes. Payment is handled by Stripe. I never see your card details.
